items.title: Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) misses Q3 2026 revenue estimates
items.summary: Defense contractor Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as revenue rose 3.6% year on year to $4.63 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $18.1 billion at the midpoint came in 1.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.62 per share was 19% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
